name: Google Perspective
label: Perspective API — comment toxicity scores
description: Official Jigsaw Perspective Comment Analyzer. POST https://commentanalyzer.googleapis.com/v1alpha1/comments:analyze. operation=analyze returns attribute scores only (TOXICITY and related attributes) — not a ban engine and not a moderator decision. Auth: Google API key as x-goog-api-key. Service remains active until 2026-12-31 (sunset announced). Docs: https://developers.perspectiveapi.com/s/about-the-api-methods.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Official AnalyzeComment JSON. comment.text is required. requestedAttributes typically {"TOXICITY":{}}. Do not put api_key here. Example: {"comment":{"text":"Thanks for the helpful reply."},"requestedAttributes":{"TOXICITY":{}},"doNotStore":true,"languages":["en"]}.

schema.label: comment
schema.description: Comment.text object {text, type?}. Required. type EXACT: PLAIN_TEXT | HTML. Example: {"text":"This is a comment.","type":"PLAIN_TEXT"}.

schema.label: requestedAttributes
schema.description: Map of attribute→{scoreThreshold?}. Keys: TOXICITY, SEVERE_TOXICITY, IDENTITY_ATTACK, INSULT, PROFANITY, THREAT, … Example: {"TOXICITY":{}}.

schema.label: languages
schema.description: ISO 639-1 codes (en, es, fr, …). Omit to auto-detect. Production TOXICITY languages include ar, zh, cs, nl, en, fr, de, hi, id, it, ja, ko, pl, pt, ru, es.

schema.label: doNotStore
schema.description: If true, Perspective must not store comment/context. Set true for private text or content from anyone under 13. Default false on the API if omitted.

schema.label: spanAnnotations
schema.description: If true, return per-span scores. Default false.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data.attributeScores (probability scores 0–1). Scores only — the workflow must not treat a score as an automatic ban. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON. attributeScores.<NAME>.summaryScore.value is the probability score.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: Perspective / Google Cloud API key. Sent as x-goog-api-key. StudioQuack secret. Never on INPUT. Never logged. New usage requests closed after February 2026; API ends 2026-12-31.
